books.title: Hello, Butterfly
books.art_why: Butterflies are real animals that can be photographed.

pages.brief: A big butterfly fills the view, with wide open wings, two long antennae, and a clear body. It is shown alone against a soft plain background, resting calmly with its wings spread so its large size is easy to see.
A small butterfly is shown alone against a soft plain background. Its wings are open, its antennae are thin, and its body is tiny. It rests calmly in clear view, making its small size easy to see.

A red butterfly is shown alone in clear view, with red wings spread open. Its antennae and body are visible, and the red color covers the wings. It rests calmly against a soft plain background so the bright color stands out.

A green butterfly is shown alone in clear view, with green wings spread open. Its antennae and body are visible, and the green color covers the wings. It rests calmly against a soft plain background so the green color stands out.

A striped butterfly is shown alone in clear view, with striped wings spread open. Its antennae and body are visible, and the stripes cross the wings. It rests calmly against a soft plain background so the striped pattern stands out.

A spotted butterfly is shown alone in clear view, with spotted wings spread open. Its antennae and body are visible, and spots mark the wings. It rests calmly against a soft plain background so the spotted pattern stands out.

A new butterfly is shown alone in clear view, with fresh wings spread open. Its antennae and body are visible, and it rests calmly against a soft plain background. Its wings look clean and newly formed, with no other object nearby.

books.title: Muscles
books.art_why: Muscles and children moving are real, everyday things a camera can show.

pages.brief: A young girl in a t-shirt and shorts stands in a sunny playground, knees bent and arms swung up as she jumps off the ground, both feet in the air above the grass, her face bright and happy.
The same young girl runs across a grassy park, one foot forward and one behind, arms pumping, ponytail swinging, smiling as she moves, with open grass and a low fence behind her.
The girl leans forward with both hands flat on a big cardboard box in a bright room, arms straight and feet braced, pushing it slowly across the floor, her face determined and focused.
The girl bends her knees in a garden and lifts a full watering can with both hands, arms tight and cheeks puffed, holding it up at waist height while standing steady on the grass.
The girl stands tall on a mat indoors and stretches both arms high above her head, reaching up on tiptoe, back long and chin lifted, her eyes looking upward as her body extends.
The girl grips a thick rope tied to a small wooden cart on a path and pulls it toward herself, leaning back with bent elbows and feet dug in, the cart rolling slowly behind her.
The girl stands on a grassy field and kicks a round ball with one foot, the other foot planted, arms out for balance, the ball lifting off the grass in front of her.
A close, warm picture of the girl's face as she smiles widely, cheeks lifted and eyes crinkled, her whole happy expression showing the muscles that make a smile.

books.title: Going Places
books.art_why: Real vehicles and a horse exist today, so photos fit.

pages.text: You can go on a plane. You can go on a train.
pages.brief: A plane with wings and windows flies through the sky, while a train with carriages and wheels travels along a track below. The two vehicles are shown clearly in a bright outdoor scene, side by side as different ways to go places.

pages.text: You can go on a boat. You can go in a car.
pages.brief: A boat with a hull and cabin floats on water, and a car with wheels and windows drives along a nearby road. The boat and car are both shown clearly in an outdoor setting, side by side as two ways to travel.

pages.text: You can go in a bus. You can go on a bike.
pages.brief: A bus with windows and wheels travels along a street, and a bicycle with two wheels and handlebars stands or moves on a nearby path. Both are shown clearly in a bright outdoor scene as ways to go places.

pages.text: You can go on a skateboard. 10 You can go on a horse.
pages.brief: A skateboard with a deck and four wheels is shown on a smooth surface, and a horse stands nearby in an open outdoor area. Both appear clearly as ways to go places, side by side in the same bright scene.

books.title: My Body
books.art_why: A body-parts book shows real children and real body parts that exist today.

pages.text: This is my foot. This is my leg.
pages.brief: A close, simple photo shows a young child's bare foot in the foreground and the same child's leg beside it, with soft even light on plain skin. The foot and leg are still and clearly visible, filling most of the frame without any extra objects or background details.

pages.text: This is my belly. This is my chest.
pages.brief: A simple close-up photo shows a child's bare belly and chest, with the belly low in the frame and the chest above it. The child is still, and both body parts are clearly visible in soft, even light against a plain background, with no other objects or people.

pages.text: This is my hand. This is my arm.
pages.brief: A simple close-up photo shows a young child's hand held open beside the same child's arm. The hand and arm are still and clearly visible, with soft even light and a plain background, filling the frame without any extra objects, clothing details, or other people.

A simple close-up photo shows a young child's head facing forward, with the face and hair clearly visible. The head is still in soft, even light against a plain background, filling most of the frame, with no other people, objects, or background details shown.

A simple photo shows a young child's whole body standing still, facing forward, with the head, arms, belly, legs, and feet all visible. The child fills most of the frame in soft, even light against a plain background, with no other people or objects around.

books.title: How Many in All?
books.art_why: Counting toys such as bears, rings and dogs are real objects a camera can photograph.

pages.text: There are three blue bears. There are three green bears.
pages.brief: Six small toy bears arranged in two neat rows on a light wooden table. The top row holds three blue bears, the bottom row three green bears, all sitting upright with round ears and stitched smiles, facing the viewer in soft daylight.

The same six toy bears sit together in one mixed group on the wooden table, blue and green side by side, waiting to be counted. A plain pale wall behind them, soft even light, empty space at the sides, no hands or people in the frame.

pages.text: There are four thin rings. There are three thick rings.
pages.brief: Four thin hoops and three thick hoops lie flat on a plain floor, the thin ones slim and light-coloured, the thick ones chunky and darker, spread out with clear gaps between them so each ring can be seen on its own.

The four thin rings and three thick rings are gathered into one loose pile on the same plain floor, overlapping slightly at the edges, thin and thick shapes clearly different, soft shadows beneath them and empty floor around.

pages.text: There are four sitting dogs. There are five standing dogs.
pages.brief: Nine toy dogs on a pale rug, four of them sitting on their haunches with front paws down, five standing on all four legs nearby, mixed colours and sizes, ears up, tails out, spaced apart so each dog is visible from nose to paws.

The same nine toy dogs now grouped together on the rug, sitting and standing dogs mingling in one loose cluster, some facing left and some right, soft shadows under their paws, plain background with nothing else in the room.

A scattering of small metal jacks on a bare wooden floor, six-pointed star shapes resting at different angles, some on their sides and some upright, soft shadows beneath them, plain empty background, overhead light, nothing else in the picture.

books.title: Go Fly a Kite
books.art_why: Kites and kite-flying are real things that can be photographed.

pages.brief: A fish-shaped kite is flying in the open air. The kite has a fish body, fins and a tail shape, and it is shown lifted by the wind against a simple sky background. It is the main subject of the picture.

A plane-shaped kite is flying in the open air. The kite has an airplane body and wing shapes, and it is shown lifted by the wind against a simple sky background. It is the main subject of the picture.

A shark-shaped kite is flying in the open air. The kite has a shark body shape with fins and a tail, and it is shown lifted by the wind against a simple sky background. It is the main subject of the picture.

A bird-shaped kite is flying in the open air. The kite has a bird body shape with wing shapes and a tail, and it is shown lifted by the wind against a simple sky background. It is the main subject of the picture.
A boat-shaped kite is flying in the open air. The kite has a boat body shape, and it is shown lifted by the wind against a simple sky background. It is the main subject of the picture.

A butterfly-shaped kite is flying in the open air. The kite has a butterfly body shape with wing shapes, and it is shown lifted by the wind against a simple sky background. It is the main subject of the picture.

A dragon-shaped kite is flying in the open air. The kite has a dragon body shape with wing shapes and a tail, and it is shown lifted by the wind against a simple sky background. It is the main subject of the picture.

A rainbow-shaped kite is flying in the open air. The kite is shaped with rainbow color bands, and it is shown lifted by the wind against a simple sky background. It is the main subject of the picture.

books.title: Getting Dressed
books.art_why: Every item of clothing and the child wearing it exist in the real world today, so photographs suit this book.

pages.brief: A young boy stands in his bedroom in the morning, holding a shirt with both hands and pulling it over his head and arms, his face cheerful. A low bed with a blanket sits behind him and a wooden dresser stands against the wall.

The same young boy in the same bedroom sits on the edge of his bed, lifting one leg and then the other into a pair of pants, tugging them up to his waist. His bare feet rest on the floor and the dresser is nearby.

The boy stands beside his bed with his pants on, threading a belt through the loops at his waist and fastening the buckle with both hands. He looks down at what he is doing, and the bedroom dresser and blanket are visible.
Sitting on the floor of his bedroom, the boy pulls a sock onto one foot, then reaches for the second sock beside him. His shoes wait on the floor nearby and the edge of his bed is close.
The boy sits on the floor with both socks on, pushing his foot into a shoe and pressing the heel down, then reaching for the other shoe. His bedroom floor, bed and dresser are around him.

Standing in his bedroom, dressed in shirt, pants, belt, socks and shoes, the boy lifts a pair of glasses to his face and slides the arms over his ears. He smiles, and his bed and dresser are behind him.
The boy stands by the bedroom door, arms pushed into the sleeves of a jacket, shrugging it onto his shoulders and pulling the front closed. His glasses are on his face and his backpack rests nearby.
Ready for the day, the boy stands near the door with his backpack on both shoulders, holding the straps, smiling. He wears his glasses and jacket, and his bedroom with bed and dresser is behind him.

books.title: Athletes
books.art_why: All eight sports and the athletes are real and photographed today.

pages.brief: Several athletes in running vests and shorts sprint along an outdoor running track, arms driving and legs stretched mid-stride. Lane lines curve across the track beneath them, and grass and stadium seating sit behind. Their faces show effort and speed, with one runner slightly ahead of the others in the sunshine.

Two athletes in football kit play on a green grass pitch, one planting a foot and swinging a leg to kick a black-and-white ball. The other player leans in, watching the ball. Goals and a low fence are behind them, and the grass shows worn patches where the players have been moving.

Athletes in swim caps and goggles swim laps in a bright blue indoor swimming pool, arms reaching forward out of the water and faces turned to breathe. White lane ropes divide the water into lanes, and splashes and ripples spread around each swimmer along the length of the pool.

An athlete in a swimsuit stands at the end of a diving board above a blue pool, body bent and arms swung back ready to spring. Below, the water surface waits. Other divers and a coach stand on the poolside behind, and the tall ceiling of the pool building rises overhead.

An athlete on an open sports field throws a heavy ball from the shoulder, one arm extended and the other out for balance, shoes planted in a throwing circle. Officials and other athletes watch from a safe distance across the grass, and a measuring tape and markers lie near the circle.

Athletes in helmets and tight cycling clothes ride racing bicycles along a paved road, leaning forward over the handlebars and pedalling. Their wheels are close together in a line, and trees and a grassy verge run alongside the road under a bright sky.

Athletes in a long narrow rowing boat pull their oars together across calm water, leaning back as the blades sweep. Their coach sits in a small motorboat nearby, watching. Trees and a grassy riverbank line the far shore, and long ripples trail behind the boat.

Athletes stand together at the finish of a race with arms raised high, smiling and cheering. One holds a shining medal, and others hug each other. Flags and spectators fill the background of the stadium, with the track and grass visible around them.

books.title: Spring and Fall
books.art_why: Real-world seasonal nature and a child can be photographed.

pages.brief: A close-up outdoor view shows fresh green leaves opening on thin branches in spring. The young leaves are small and bright, catching soft daylight, with only the leafy branches visible around them against a clear background.

A close-up outdoor view shows autumn leaves in rich red, orange, and yellow colors on branches in fall. The leaves look dry and curled at some edges, with soft daylight falling across them and only leafy branches visible.

Two small birds sit alertly on an outdoor branch in spring, surrounded by fresh green leaves. Their feathers and bright eyes are clearly visible as they perch together in soft daylight, with only the branch and spring foliage around them.

Two small birds perch on an outdoor branch in fall, with autumn-colored leaves around them. Their feathers are clear in soft daylight as they rest together, and only the branch and seasonal foliage appear in the scene.

Young corn plants grow in neat rows in an outdoor field in spring. The corn is small and green, with slender leaves reaching upward from the soil under soft daylight, and only the young crop and field rows are visible around them.

Tall corn stalks stand in an outdoor field in fall. The corn plants are mature and golden-green, with full ears and dry leaves, filling the rows under soft daylight, and only the ripe corn crop and field are visible.

A young child stands outdoors in spring, smiling at the viewer. The child wears light spring clothing, with fresh green leaves and soft daylight around them, and only the child and spring greenery are shown.

The same young child stands outdoors in fall, smiling broadly at the viewer. The child wears warmer autumn clothing, with red and yellow leaves and soft daylight around them, and only the child and autumn foliage are shown.

books.title: Grandparents Are Great!
books.art_why: Real grandparents doing everyday activities exist today and can be photographed.

pages.brief: A cheerful group of grandparents stands together, smiling — grandmothers and grandfathers of different ages, with grey and white hair, warm sweaters and comfortable clothes. They look happy and proud, arms around one another, in a bright, simple outdoor setting with soft green grass behind them.

pages.text: Some grandparents cook. Some grandparents swim.
pages.brief: On the left, a grandmother in an apron stirs a big pot on a kitchen stove, steam rising, jars and spoons on the counter. On the right, a grandfather in swim trunks and goggles swims laps in a blue pool, one arm raised out of the water, sunlight sparkling on the surface.

pages.text: Some grandparents hike. Some grandparents golf.
pages.brief: A grandfather with a walking stick and a small backpack hikes up a rocky dirt trail between tall trees, stepping over a root. Nearby, a grandmother in a visor and polo shirt swings a golf club on a green fairway, a small white ball on the grass and a flag in the distance.

pages.text: Some grandparents sew. Some grandparents garden.
pages.brief: A grandmother sits at a sewing machine, guiding bright fabric under the needle, a spool of thread and scissors beside her. Next to her, a grandfather in a wide hat kneels in a garden, pressing small green plants into dark soil with a trowel, rows of vegetables behind him.

pages.text: Some grandparents paint. Some grandparents read.
pages.brief: A grandfather stands at a wooden easel, brush in hand, painting a bright picture on canvas, pots of colour on a small table. Beside him, a grandmother settles into a soft armchair with an open book on her lap, reading in a warm, quiet room.

books.title: This Insect
books.art_why: This book shows real insects with visible features, so photographs fit best.

pages.brief: A close-up of a strong insect, with a sturdy body and thick legs braced firmly, shown large against a plain background. The insect holds a powerful, steady pose, filling most of the frame so its strength is easy to see.

A close-up of a fast insect, with wings or legs caught in quick motion, shown against a plain background. The insect is moving swiftly across the frame, body angled forward, with a clear sense of speed and energy.
A close-up of a furry insect, its body covered in soft fuzz, shown against a plain background. The insect rests calmly, filling most of the frame so the furry texture is clear and easy to see.

A close-up of a skinny insect, with a thin, narrow body and slender legs, shown against a plain background. The insect stands clearly in the frame, filling most of the view, its delicate shape easy to see.

A close-up of a shiny insect, its body smooth and glossy, shown against a plain background. The insect catches the light, with bright highlights on its surface, filling most of the frame so the shine is easy to see.
A close-up of a spotted insect, with clear spots across its body, shown large against a plain background. The insect rests calmly, filling most of the frame so the spotted pattern is easy to see.
A close-up of a striped insect, with clear stripes across its body, shown large against a plain background. The insect stands calmly, filling most of the frame so the striped pattern is easy to see.

A close-up of a beautiful insect, with bright colours and delicate wings, shown against a plain background. The insect rests calmly, filling most of the frame so its lovely shape and colours are easy to see.

books.title: For Mom
books.art_why: A everyday family scene with a real child and mother, which a camera can photograph today.

pages.brief: A small child sits at a low table in a sunny room, holding a crayon and drawing a picture on paper, looking up toward Mom, who stands beside the table watching with a warm smile.
In a bright kitchen, a small child stands on a sturdy step stool at the counter, stirring a bowl with a spoon, with Mom close beside her, both of them looking at the bowl together.
A small child stands in the middle of a living room, mouth open wide, singing happily to Mom, who sits on the sofa nearby, smiling and listening with her hands resting in her lap.
A small child kneels on the floor of a tidy room, wiping a low surface with a cloth, while Mom stands nearby holding a small bucket and watching the child help.
A small child walks carefully across a room, holding something securely in both arms, carrying it toward Mom, who waits with open hands and a proud, encouraging look.
A small child stands close to Mom, face lifted, giving her a big happy smile, and Mom smiles right back down at the child in a warm, quiet moment together.
A small child sits beside Mom on a sofa, holding an open picture book on her lap, showing the pages to Mom, who leans in to look at the pictures with her.
A small child lies in bed under a soft blanket, eyes closed and peaceful, with Mom sitting gently on the edge of the bed, watching the child drift off to sleep in the dim room.

books.title: Dad and I
books.art_why: A dad and child doing everyday real activities like baking, swimming and biking are best shown in real photographs.

pages.brief: A dad and his young child stand together at a kitchen counter, both pressing and shaping dough with their hands. A bowl and a baking tray sit on the counter beside them. The dad leans in close to help the child, and both are smiling in the warm kitchen light.

A dad and his young child are in a swimming pool, the child held up in the dad's arms with water up to their chests. Splashes of water fly around them and the child's face is bright with joy. Ripples spread across the blue pool around the two of them.

A dad and his young child kneel on the soil in a garden, the dad pressing a small plant into the earth while the child pats the dirt around it. A trowel and a watering can rest on the ground nearby. Green plants and rows of soil fill the space around them.

A dad and his young child sit on the floor together playing with a few toys between them. The dad holds one toy out toward the child, who reaches for it with both hands. Both are laughing, surrounded by the toys spread out on the rug.

A dad and his young child ride bicycles side by side along a path, the child on a smaller bike with training wheels. The dad rides close beside, glancing over at the child. Trees and open ground stretch along the path behind them.

A dad and his young child walk hand in hand along a path outdoors, the child taking big steps to keep up. The dad looks down at the child as they go. Grass and trees line the way ahead of them under a bright sky.

A dad and his young child sit at a table with paper and pencils, both writing and drawing. The child holds a pencil in a small fist, tongue out in concentration, while the dad writes beside them. Their papers are spread across the tabletop.

A dad kneels down and wraps his young child in a big hug, the child's arms around his neck. Both have their eyes closed and happy faces. They are inside a simple room, held close together in the middle of the picture.

books.title: Where to Go
books.art_why: The book shows real places and events that exist today, so photographs fit best.

pages.brief: A bright outdoor playground with a slide, swings and a climbing frame. The playground is empty and clearly visible, showing the place named in the simple direction. Safe play surface and open space make the location easy for young readers to recognise.

A clean swimming pool with blue water, lane markers and a wide pool deck. No one is swimming in this view; the pool itself is the clear subject, showing the place named in the simple direction. Bright light makes the water easy to see.

A peaceful woodland with tall trees, leafy branches and a clear path leading among them. The woods are shown as the place to go, with dappled light and green undergrowth. No people or animals are added; the focus stays on the trees and path.

A museum entrance or gallery room with display cases and framed exhibits but no readable labels. The calm indoor space shows the museum as the place named in the simple direction. Clear open floor lets young readers recognise the setting without extra actions or events.

A sandy beach beside calm blue water, with open sand and gentle waves. The beach is shown as the place to go, with a wide sky above and a clear shoreline. No people or beach toys are added; the focus stays on the sand and sea.

A sports game in a stadium, with a marked field and empty spectator stands. The game is shown as the place to go, with goalposts and boundary lines clearly visible. No specific players or teams are named; the focus stays on the game setting.

A lively parade moving along a street, with decorated floats and marching groups. The parade is shown as the place to go, with crowds watching from the sides. Bright colours and open street space make the event easy for young readers to recognise.

A simple bedroom with a bed, pillow and blanket, shown as the place to go at the end of the day. The bed is neat and ready, with soft light and a calm setting. No person is shown; the focus stays on the bed and the quiet room.

books.title: Christmas Cookies
books.art_why: Christmas cookies are real objects that exist today and can be photographed.

pages.brief: A batch of star-shaped Christmas cookies rests on a baking tray in a kitchen. The cookies are pale golden and cut into clear star shapes, ready for the holiday. The tray fills the scene, showing only star cookies.

A batch of bell-shaped Christmas cookies sits on a baking tray in a kitchen. Each cookie is cut into a clear bell shape with a small handle at the top, ready for the holiday. The tray shows only bell cookies.

pages.text: Make snowflake cookies. Make tree cookies.
pages.brief: Snowflake-shaped Christmas cookies and tree-shaped Christmas cookies rest on a baking tray in a kitchen. The snowflake cookies have delicate branching patterns, and the tree cookies are cut like small evergreen trees, ready for the holiday.

A batch of flower-shaped Christmas cookies lies on a baking tray in a kitchen. Each cookie is cut into a clear flower shape with rounded petals, ready for the holiday. The tray shows only flower cookies, arranged neatly for baking.

A batch of snowman-shaped Christmas cookies sits on a baking tray in a kitchen. Each cookie is cut into a clear snowman shape with a round head and body, ready for the holiday. The tray shows only snowman cookies.

A batch of candle-shaped Christmas cookies rests on a baking tray in a kitchen. Each cookie is cut into a clear candle shape with a tall body and small flame, ready for the holiday. The tray shows only candle cookies.

A batch of Santa-shaped Christmas cookies sits on a baking tray in a kitchen. Each cookie is cut into a clear Santa shape with a hat and beard, ready for the holiday. The tray shows only Santa cookies, arranged for Christmas.

books.title: Time for Eggs
books.art_why: Real eggs and everyday kitchen actions can be shown in photographs.

pages.brief: A close, clear photo shows several brown and white eggs resting in a straw nest, partly hidden among the straw and waiting to be found. The eggs sit close together in soft natural light, with the nest filling most of the frame.
A pair of hands gently collects the eggs from the straw nest, lifting them one by one and gathering them together. The brown and white eggs are held carefully so they stay whole and do not roll away.

The collected eggs are carried together in a shallow container, held steady and level. A pair of hands supports the container from below as the brown and white eggs rest safely inside and move from one place to another.
The eggs are laid out in a row and counted one by one. Several brown and white eggs sit on a clean surface, spaced apart so each one is easy to see and count in the simple real photo.

The eggs are cleaned under running water, one by one. Brown and white shells look wet and shiny as careful hands rub away dirt, keeping every egg whole. Water droplets catch the light in the clear close-up photo.

An egg is cracked open, its shell breaking and the inside slipping out into a bowl. A hand holds the egg over the bowl, and the cracked egg sits ready with broken shell pieces nearby in the clear real photo.
The eggs cook in a pan over heat, turning firm and golden. A hand holds a spatula nearby, and the pan sits on a stove as the eggs are shown cooking in the clear real photo, with steam rising softly.
The cooked eggs are eaten from a plate, ready to be enjoyed. A fork lifts a piece of egg, and the plate sits on a table in the clear real photo, showing the finished food.

books.title: All Kinds of Buttons
books.art_why: Buttons are real objects that exist today, so photographs suit this simple concept book.

pages.brief: A single round button is shown alone in close-up, centered clearly against a plain background. Its circular shape is easy to see, with a smooth edge all the way around. The button fills the main view so young readers can notice its round form.

A single square button is shown alone in close-up, centered clearly against a plain background. Its four straight sides and four corners are easy to see. The button fills the main view so young readers can notice its square shape.

A single wooden button is shown alone in close-up, centered clearly against a plain background. Its surface looks like wood, with natural grain and warm brown tones. The button is the only object in view, making its wooden material easy to see.

A single metal button is shown alone in close-up, centered clearly against a plain background. Its surface looks hard and metallic, with a cool grey shine. The button is the only object in view, making its metal material easy to see.

A single dark button is shown alone in close-up, centered clearly against a plain background. Its color is deep and dark, with little brightness across the surface. The button fills the main view so young readers can notice its dark appearance.

A single shiny button is shown alone in close-up, centered clearly against a plain background. Light reflects brightly from its smooth surface, making it gleam. The button fills the main view so young readers can notice its shiny finish.

A single small button is shown alone in close-up, centered clearly against a plain background. It looks tiny in the frame, with plenty of empty space around it. The button is the only object in view, making its small size easy to see.

A single large button is shown alone in close-up, centered clearly against a plain background. It looks big in the frame, taking up most of the view. The button is the only object in view, making its large size easy to see.

books.title: Move It!
books.art_why: The book shows real toys in action, which can be photographed.

pages.brief: A bright toy is shown in a clear moving pose, as if it has just been set in motion. The toy fills the frame against a simple background, with no other objects around it. Its position suggests action and energy, inviting a young reader to look closely at how it moves.

A single toy is caught at the moment it bounces. It is lifted off the ground with a springy, upward motion, its shape clear and easy to see. The background is plain so the bouncing action stands out for a young reader.

A single toy is shown rolling along. Its rounded shape and position make the rolling motion easy to see. It sits on a simple, open surface with nothing else in the frame, keeping attention on the toy and the way it moves.

A single toy is shown spinning in place. Its pose and blurred motion suggest it is turning around quickly. The toy is centered against a plain background, with no other objects nearby, so a young reader can focus on the spinning action.

A single toy with a moving part is shown dumping something out. The toy is tipped or opened so the contents can fall, and the dumping action is clear. The background is simple, with nothing else in the frame to distract from the toy.

A single toy is shown flying through the air. It is lifted above the ground with clear space around it, making the flying motion easy to see. The background is plain, so the toy and its movement stay the focus for a young reader.

A single toy is shown spraying something out. A fine spray comes from the toy, and the action is clear and simple. The toy is centered against a plain background, with no other objects in the frame, keeping attention on the spraying.

A single toy is shown floating on water. It rests on the surface without sinking, and its position makes the floating action clear. The background is simple, with only the water and the toy, so a young reader can see what floating looks like.

A single toy is shown falling downward. It is caught in mid-air with clear space below it, making the falling motion easy to see. The background is plain, so the toy and its downward movement stay the focus.

books.title: Make a Salad
books.art_why: Real salad ingredients and a real kitchen can be photographed today.

pages.brief: A clear glass salad bowl rests on a light wooden kitchen counter. Crisp, ruffled green lettuce leaves are being dropped into the bowl, filling the bottom. The leaves overlap and curl at the edges, bright and fresh, with a few water droplets still shining on their surface.

The same glass bowl with green lettuce in the bottom sits on the wooden counter. Thin sliced rings of onion, white and pale purple with pink edges, fall onto the lettuce. Several rings land in a loose pile, separated and overlapping, showing their layered curves.

In the glass bowl on the wooden counter, shiny strips of bell pepper drop onto the lettuce and onion. The pepper pieces are cut into narrow lengths, glossy and firm, landing in a small heap on top of the other ingredients.

Round orange carrot slices fall into the glass bowl on the wooden counter, landing on the peppers and lettuce. The slices are thin coins with a paler core ring in the middle, stacked loosely and scattered across the top of the salad.

Chunks of red tomato drop into the glass bowl on the wooden counter. The tomato pieces are cut into wedges, wet and shining, with visible seeds and juicy flesh, settling among the lettuce, onion, peppers and carrot slices.

Deep red beet slices fall into the glass bowl on the wooden counter. The slices are thin and dark crimson, with faint rings running through them, landing on the tomatoes and other ingredients and staining the pieces around them a little.

Grated cheese sprinkles down into the glass bowl on the wooden counter, scattering over the beets, tomatoes, carrots, peppers, onion and lettuce. The shreds are pale yellow and fine, falling in a soft shower and settling in a light layer on top.

Dressing pours from a small glass jug into the glass bowl on the wooden counter. The pale, glossy stream falls over the piled salad, coating the cheese, beets, tomatoes, carrots, peppers, onion and lettuce, and pooling slightly at the edges of the bowl.

books.title: This Lizard
books.art_why: Real lizards exist today and can be photographed.

pages.brief: A single large lizard fills the view outdoors, its long body and tail clearly visible. It rests calmly, showing its size with no other animal in view, so the big scale is easy to see. Natural daylight makes its skin and shape clear.

A tiny lizard is shown outdoors, its whole little body and tail visible in close view. It rests calmly, making its small size easy to see. Natural daylight shows its shape and skin clearly, with no other animal in view.

A colorful lizard is shown outdoors, its whole body and tail visible. Bright patches of different colors cover its skin, making it stand out clearly. It rests calmly in natural daylight, with no other animal in view.

A plain lizard is shown outdoors, its whole body and tail visible. Its skin is simple and even in color, without bright patterns, so the plain look is clear. It rests calmly in natural daylight, with no other animal in view.

A bumpy lizard is shown outdoors, its whole body and tail visible. Raised bumps cover its skin, giving it a rough, uneven surface that is easy to see. It rests calmly in natural daylight, with no other animal in view.

A smooth lizard is shown outdoors, its whole body and tail visible. Its skin looks even and sleek, with no rough bumps, so the smooth surface is easy to see. It rests calmly in natural daylight, with no other animal in view.

A spotted lizard is shown outdoors, its whole body and tail visible. Clear spots mark its skin, standing out against the rest of its color. It rests calmly in natural daylight, with no other animal in view.

A striped lizard is shown outdoors, its whole body and tail visible. Clear stripes run along its skin, standing out against the rest of its color. It rests calmly in natural daylight, with no other animal in view.

books.title: Hot and Cold
books.art_why: Real hot and cold objects, places and people can be photographed in everyday life.

pages.text: Things can be hot or cold.
pages.brief: On a wooden table, a steaming mug of hot drink sits beside a small bowl of ice cubes. Thin wisps of steam rise from the mug, while the ice cubes glisten with cold. Together they are things that can be hot or cold.
A wide desert stretches under a blazing sun. Golden sand dunes roll to the horizon, and the air shimmers with heat. No trees or water are in sight. The bright, dry place feels very hot.

A snowy field lies under a pale winter sky. Thick snow covers the ground and bends the branches of a few bare trees. Frost hangs in the still air, and everything looks quiet and frozen. This place is very cold.
A bowl of hot soup steams on a kitchen table. A spoon rests beside the bowl, and warm steam curls upward into the air. The soup looks thick and comforting, ready to eat. This food is hot.
A scoop of ice cream sits in a small bowl on a table. The ice cream is pale and frosty, with tiny cold droplets around the bowl. A spoon waits nearby. This food is cold.
A child in summer clothes stands outdoors under a bright sun. Sweat beads on the child's forehead, and they fan their face with one hand. The air is warm and still. This person feels hot.

pages.text: People can be cold. Things can be hot or cold.
pages.brief: A child bundled in a thick coat, hat and scarf stands shivering in a snowy park, arms hugged around themselves. Nearby on a bench sit a steaming mug and a bowl of ice cubes, showing things that can be hot or cold.
A split scene shows hot and cold. On one side, a bright sun beats down on warm desert sand and a steaming cup. On the other side, snowflakes fall over icy ground and a bowl of ice cubes.

books.title: What Lives Here?
books.art_why: Real animals and a child exist today, so photographs fit.

pages.brief: A wide natural outdoor scene shows several animals gathered together in a shared home place. The animals are visible in the open setting, with room around them to show that many different animals can live in this same kind of place.

A bear is shown in its natural outdoor home, standing or moving in the place where it lives. The bear fills the scene as the main animal, with a simple natural background around it that shows its habitat.

A deer is shown in its natural outdoor home, standing among the surroundings where it lives. The deer is the main animal in the scene, with a simple natural background that shows the place it shares with other living things.

A fish is shown in the water where it lives, swimming in its underwater home. The fish is the main subject, with water around it and a simple underwater setting that shows the place where this animal makes its home.

pages.text: A frog lives here. A worm lives here.
pages.brief: A frog and a worm are shown in the natural places where they live. The frog sits in its home setting, and the worm rests in the ground nearby, each animal shown in the kind of place that is its home.

A bee is shown in the outdoor place where it lives, resting or moving near the natural surroundings of its home. The bee is the main subject, with a simple background that shows the kind of place where this small animal lives.
A child is shown in a home setting, standing or sitting in the place where the child lives. The child is the main subject, with a simple indoor background around them that shows a familiar home.

books.title: Mom and I
books.art_why: The book shows real animals that exist today, so photographs fit best.

pages.text: Mom and I are lions. Mom and I are elephants.
pages.brief: A mother lion stands with her cub on a sunny grassy savanna, both looking forward. Nearby, a mother elephant walks beside her small calf across dry earth, the calf close to her side under bright sky.

pages.text: Mom and I are giraffes. Mom and I are zebras.
pages.brief: A tall mother giraffe stands beside her young on open grassland, their long necks reaching up. Close by, a mother zebra and her foal stand together among short grass, the foal's stripes clear in warm sunlight.

pages.text: Mom and I are bears. Mom and I are apes.
pages.brief: A mother bear and her cub sit near rocks and trees, the cub staying close. Beside them, a mother ape holds her baby in a leafy forest, both sitting quietly among branches and green leaves.

pages.text: Mom and I are kangaroos. Mom and I are dolphins.
pages.brief: A mother kangaroo stands on dry grass with her joey near her pouch, both facing forward. In blue water nearby, a mother dolphin swims beside her calf, their smooth bodies shining as they move together.

books.title: Baby Animals
books.art_why: Baby animals exist in the real world today, so photographs suit every page.

pages.brief: A single fluffy puppy stands facing forward, its soft ears flopping beside its round face. Its bright eyes look ahead and its small paws rest together. The young dog is shown alone in a clean, simple space with nothing else around it.

A tiny chick stands upright, its soft yellow down covering its small body. Its little beak points forward and its thin legs hold it steady. The baby bird is alone in a plain, simple setting, with no other animals or objects nearby.

A young cub sits low, looking forward with round eyes and soft fur. Its sturdy little paws rest on the ground and its ears stand alert. The small animal is shown by itself in a simple, empty space with nothing else in view.

A young calf stands broadside, its long legs planted and its soft coat smooth. Its large eyes look gently forward and its ears rest at the sides of its head. The baby cow is alone in a clean, open space with nothing else around.

A small kid stands with its short legs set apart and its soft coat neat. Its little horns show on top and its bright eyes look ahead. The young goat is alone in a plain, simple space, with no other animal or object nearby.

A fluffy lamb stands facing forward, its woolly coat soft and full. Its slender legs hold it steady and its ears sit close to its face. The baby sheep is alone in a quiet, simple setting with nothing else around it.

A young foal stands tall on long, slim legs, its short mane neat and its coat smooth. Its ears point up and its dark eyes look ahead. The baby horse is shown alone in a plain, uncluttered space with nothing else nearby.

books.title: Spring Weather
books.art_why: Real spring weather is best shown with photos.

pages.brief: A wide outdoor view shows fog coming in and filling the air. Soft grey fog rolls forward across the open scene, making everything cloudy and dim. The fog keeps coming and spreading through the picture.

A wide sky view shows clouds coming in and gathering above. The clouds move forward across the open view, filling the sky with soft grey shapes. More clouds keep coming and spreading through the picture.

A wide outdoor view shows a storm coming in. Dark heavy clouds gather overhead as the storm arrives across the open scene. The storm keeps coming, bringing a gloomy, unsettled look to the whole picture.

A wide outdoor view shows rain coming down from the sky. Steady rain falls across the open scene, filling the air with falling drops. The rain keeps coming and covers the whole view with wet, rainy weather.

A wide outdoor view shows wind coming through. Visible gusts sweep across the open scene, moving the air and making the view look breezy. The strong wind keeps coming and blows through the whole picture.
A wide sky view shows the sun coming out. Bright sunlight shines across the open scene from the sun in the sky. The sun keeps coming through, making the whole picture look bright and clear.
A wide outdoor view shows flowers coming up. Small flowers open and appear across the open scene, adding colour to the picture. The flowers keep coming, and more of them show in the spring weather.

A wide outdoor view shows spring coming. The season arrives across the open scene, with the weather changing and the spring beginning. Spring keeps coming, bringing a bright fresh new season to the whole picture.
